data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google's ML Kit On-Device Translation.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses Google's ML Kit On-Device Translation to dynamically translate text between more than 50 languages. It provides APIs to run translation locally on the device and manage the required language models.
use_when: You need offline or on-device text translation between multiple languages.
You want to avoid sending sensitive user text to a remote translation API.
avoid_when: You need translation support on the web platform.
You want an easy Dart-only localization solution for static app strings.
strengths: Performs translation entirely on-device without needing internet connectivity during runtime.
Supports over 50 languages using native Google ML Kit APIs.
weaknesses: Does not support the web platform.
Requires manual native configuration and model management.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS deployment target 15.0 with Swift Package Manager setup, linker flags (-ObjC, -all_load), and downloading MLKitTranslate_resource.bundle. Android requires minSdkVersion 21 and compileSdkVersion 36.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: For static app localization and message formatting without heavy on-device machine learning models.

alternatives.name: flutter_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: For built-in Flutter localization support across different locales.
